name: rate-limiter-token-bucket
description: Token Bucket algorithm rate limiter for web request throttling, supporting custom capacities, refill rates, and multi-token consumption.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to implement key-based endpoint rate limiting or API throttling using the Token Bucket algorithm.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens the bucket can hold.

parameters.name: refillRate
parameters.description: Number of tokens added to the bucket per second.
